captions.detailed: A portable camping hand pump consisting of a vertical black cylinder barrel, a thin metallic silver piston rod, and a black T-handle. At the base of the cylinder is a narrow support collar with two rectangular stabilizer feet that fold outward. The T-handle and its rod slide vertically along the central axis of the cylinder, while the two stabilizer feet rotate on hinges at the base.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a portable camping pump. The pump should feature a black main cylinder body, a metallic silver piston rod with a black T-shaped handle that moves vertically (prismatic articulation), and two black rectangular stabilizer feet at the base that can fold down (revolute articulation).
captions.factory: The model is built using an assembly of multiple parts. The base and main cylinder are constructed using cylinder primitives. The piston rod is a thin cylinder, and the T-handle is composed of a block and a small connection cylinder. The stabilizer feet are modeled as rectangular boxes. These parts are connected using a prismatic joint for the piston rod to slide inside the cylinder, and revolute joints for the stabilizer feet to hinge at the base.
